# CI workflows

All jobs call `just` recipes from the root `justfile` (15 §5.1); YAML never re-implements a recipe. Toolchain comes from `mise.toml` via `.github/actions/setup`. Runners are Linux except `ios-gha-macos`.

| Workflow            | Trigger                                                                          | Tier                                                                      | Required secrets                                                                                                                        | Status                                                                                                                               |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `pr-gate.yml`       | `pull_request`, `push` to `main`                                                 | 1 - PR fast gate (< 10 min, `ci.pr_gate_duration_seconds` in job summary) | none (`TURBO_TOKEN`/`TURBO_TEAM` optional; `GITLEAKS_LICENSE` only under an org)                                                        | active (`clone-check` is a placeholder: NFR-TEAM-040 tool undecided; spectral/oasdiff skip until `packages/contracts/openapi` lands) |
| `affected.yml`      | `pull_request` touching `apps/api/**`, `packages/db/**`, `packages/contracts/**` | 2 - affected-module (< 25 min)                                            | none (pgvector service container); Neon branch variant commented out pending `NEON_API_KEY`/`NEON_PROJECT_ID`                           | active                                                                                                                               |
| `nightly.yml`       | `schedule` 03:00 UTC, `workflow_dispatch`, `workflow_call`                       | 3 - nightly, non-blocking                                                 | none                                                                                                                                    | active (`ml-eval` exit 2 = skipped; `expired-flags` and `maestro` are placeholders)                                                  |
| `pre-release.yml`   | `push` to `release/**`, `workflow_dispatch`                                      | 4 - pre-release skeleton                                                  | none in P02                                                                                                                             | placeholder (reuses nightly; device-matrix perf, store size gate, a11y checklist, restore drill print `NOT IMPLEMENTED (P14)`)       |
| `android.yml`       | `workflow_dispatch`, tags `v*`                                                   | mobile lane (Linux)                                                       | none for unsigned; `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64`, `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`, `ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS`, `ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD` for signing      | dispatch-only (no Play account yet)                                                                                                  |
| `ios-eas.yml`       | `workflow_dispatch`                                                              | mobile lane A (EAS, ADR-0002 candidate)                                   | `EXPO_TOKEN`; upload job also needs `APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_KEY_ID`, `APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_ISSUER_ID`, `APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_KEY_P8`   | dispatch-only (no Expo/Apple accounts yet; fails fast on missing secrets)                                                            |
| `ios-gha-macos.yml` | `workflow_dispatch`                                                              | mobile lane B (GHA `macos-15`, ADR-0002 candidate)                        | none for unsigned; `IOS_DIST_CERT_P12_BASE64`, `IOS_DIST_CERT_PASSWORD`, `IOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64`, `APPLE_TEAM_ID` for signing | dispatch-only (no Apple account yet)                                                                                                 |

Shared pieces:

- `.github/actions/setup/action.yml` - composite: `jdx/mise-action` (cache on), pnpm store cache keyed on `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, optional `uv sync --frozen` under `workers/**`.
- `.gitleaks.toml` (repo root) - extends the default ruleset, adds an `age` secret-key rule, allowlists `.env.example`, `planning/**`, `**/*.enc.yaml`.

Action pins (major tags, verified against each repo's latest release on 2026-09-09): `actions/checkout@v7`, `actions/cache@v6`, `actions/upload-artifact@v7`, `jdx/mise-action@v4`, `gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v3`, `expo/expo-github-action@v9`. Renovate keeps them current (15 §9).
